name: Prepare a Six-Hat Decision Review
jtbd: When a bounded what-if has source-linked arguments from competing perspectives, check perspective coverage and package unresolved questions for a human ruling.
runtime: Python >=3.11; local CLI and stdio MCP
requires: Arguments with perspective labels and source references
limitations: Does not execute BONO research fan-out or debate, does not make a ruling, and perspective labels do not create independent evidence.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.
